# Wave crests: a strip 20 m long, crests every 1.6 m, 0.28 m high; the game slides it
# one period and wraps. Origin at the water line. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Crest --base-color 0.204 0.675 0.729 --no-slot
material new Foam --base-color 0.447 0.863 0.733 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name W0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.992 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.280 --location -9.200 0 -0.070 --rotation 0 0 45
scale 1 0.35 1
apply --scale
material assign Crest
add mesh cube --name F0 --size 1 --location -9.200 -0.05 0.050
scale 0.480 0.12 0.09
apply --scale
material assign Foam
add mesh cone --name W1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.992 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.280 --location -7.600 0 -0.070 --rotation 0 0 45
